Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic Round Metal Mesh Hanging Wall Shelf Unit with 3 Shelves - 30 Inch, Natural Wood and Galvanized Iron
Materials: Stone
Display your books or tchotchkes on this circular 3-tiered shelving unit. Round iron mesh surrounds the three fir shelves for a slight nautical look, and iron bands in the back add boldness to the design. 30.12"H x 30.12"W x 6.1"D 80% iron; 20% fir Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
